ns2:course.label: Introduction to Data Analytics
ns2:course.description: Introduces students to standard approaches commonly used to analyze science and engineering data; to the strengths and limitations of the approaches; and to gain confidence in the interpretation of results. At the end of this course, students will be able to analyze a wide range of datasets using appropriate models, and draw robust conclusions. 2 undergraduate hours. 2 graduate hours. Credit is not given for ANSC 442 and ANSC 445.
